[!WARNING] This release upgrades Traefik chart to v40.x which includes a breaking change for the ingress-nginx migration: the provider name changes from kubernetesIngressNginx to kubernetesIngressNGINX. Check https://github.com/traefik/traefik-helm-chart/releases/tag/v40.0.0 for more details

This release updates Kubernetes to v1.33.13, and fixes a number of issues.

For more details on what's new, see the Kubernetes release notes.

Changes since v1.33.13+k3s1:

  • July Testing Backports (#14331)
  • July K3s Build Rework + GHA bumps (#14334)
  • Backports for 2026-07 (#14372)
  • Bump mirrored-pause to 3.10.2 (#14392)
  • Bump Traefik to v3.7.7 (#14378)
  • More backports for 2026-07 (#14409)
  • Fix typo in snapshot prune event (#14414)
  • Bump rancher/mirrored-coredns-coredns image version (#14422)
  • Bump golang:alpine image version (#14433)
  • Bump rancher/mirrored-metrics-server image version (#14438)
  • Use new Traefik v3.7.8 (#14428)
  • Bump helm-controller and klipper-helm for --force-conflicts support (#14445)
  • Bump k3s-io/kubernetes and Go references (#14454)
  • Bump etcd to v3.6.14 (#14464)
  • Fix production builds always enabling Go coverage instrumentation (#14469)
  • Bump helm-controller and klipper-helm (#14478)
